surface: SUNNYVAiLE LIBRAiRY / complete Claude guide manuscript

readerContract.humanQuestion: How do I use the Claude product I actually have to turn real source material into finished, checked work without exposing private information, buying an unnecessary plan, or mistaking a polished answer for a correct result?
readerContract.promisedPayoff: A nontechnical reader can set up and orient herself, choose the smallest suitable Claude surface, model and effort, complete the core method on Free, produce and repair useful outputs, and know when a paid or developer route has no Free equivalent.
readerContract.priorKnowledge: No coding knowledge, paid subscription, API account, model picker, installed connector or prior Claude experience is assumed.
readerContract.centralMentalModel: Claude is a family of surfaces around changing models: the result depends on the job brief, sources, context, tools, permissions, model and effort, while evidence checking and consequential decisions remain human work.
readerContract.dailyLifeConnection: The central case turns an approved proposal brief, rough notes and a spreadsheet into a leadership-ready short presentation, speaker notes, one-page summary and email draft while keeping private staff data out and preventing brainstorm notes from becoming approved promises.
readerContract.surfaceJob: A scannable, standalone Claude field guide and dated reference, not a renamed ChatGPT book, a developer manual, an advertisement or a prompt collection.
readerContract.desiredFeeling: I know where to start, what Claude can and cannot reach, how to get a useful result on Free, what to inspect, and how to correct one bad claim without starting over.

canonicalTruth.freshnessTrigger: Any change to the Claude guide job, Free/paid visibility rule or cross-book ownership.
Any Fable, Mythos, model, effort, plan, retention, context or fallback change.
Any change to official surface, model, effort, prompt, context, permission, Skill or connector guidance.
Before admission and whenever Claude products, plans, data controls, models or availability change.
If the preserved run, result summary or sample wording changes.
Any change to the four-book ownership or overlap ruling.
Any change to substantial reference-book teaching requirements.
Any change to LAiDIES public prose or spelling rules.

strengthsToUse: Separate solid current facts, account-dependent behavior, tested evidence and open uncertainty.
Turn each limitation into a specific reader decision.
patternsNotToCopy: Do not repeat one FAQ scaffold through the manuscript.
Do not inherit dated factual claims.
Do not turn every feature into a symmetrical card.

glossaryAccumulation.producerGuard: Introduce a product term only when it changes the reader's next choice; collect only a compact end index.
glossaryAccumulation.preventionEvidence: The architecture begins with one useful job and routes terms from decisions.

templateRepetition.producerGuard: Vary narrative, lookup, worked-case and troubleshooting structures while keeping Free/paid visibility explicit.
templateRepetition.preventionEvidence: One launch-pack case carries the book; feature differences appear only where needed.

decorativeAnalogy.producerGuard: Use Rewind Era material only for context limits, source authority or bounded repair, and state the limit.
decorativeAnalogy.preventionEvidence: The main job is contemporary and complete; nostalgia is not its wrapper.

referenceConfetti.producerGuard: Every practitioner or cultural reference must change an action, warning or mental model.
referenceConfetti.preventionEvidence: Named methods are attributed at the exact operating move they support.

missingMechanism.producerGuard: Explain how source authority, context, tools, permissions, model and effort change the output.
missingMechanism.preventionEvidence: The central repair traces an unauthorized promise from brainstorm note to leadership-facing copy.

genericAction.producerGuard: Give complete source text, exact prompts, outputs, inspection checks, corrections and stop lines.
genericAction.preventionEvidence: The proposal workflow is usable without another document.

jargonBeforeMeaning.producerGuard: Describe the work location and consequence before naming Projects, Artifacts, Cowork, Code, MCP, hooks or compaction.
jargonBeforeMeaning.preventionEvidence: Every technical label follows the ordinary job it solves.

disconnectedSystem.producerGuard: Connect account, settings, surface, model, effort, context, permission and verification in one end-to-end method.
disconnectedSystem.preventionEvidence: The same launch-pack job is routed across Chat, Project, Cowork and Code.

joylessInstruction.producerGuard: Write as a capable colleague solving recognizable work, with restrained earned wit and clear exits.
joylessInstruction.preventionEvidence: The reader gets usable copy and a recoverable correction, not a feature lecture.

purposeTooNarrow.producerGuard: Use the proposal pack to teach a transferable Claude operating system, then provide quick lookup and troubleshooting routes.
purposeTooNarrow.preventionEvidence: The architecture includes setup through recovery and a dated source appendix.

mechanismBeforeMotivation.producerGuard: Open with the pain of turning scattered material into reliable finished work before explaining product architecture.
mechanismBeforeMotivation.preventionEvidence: The first chapter starts from the leadership deadline and source conflict.

workedExampleOvertakesBookPurpose.producerGuard: Mark the central job as a constructed teaching case and separate it from the actual small historical test.
workedExampleOvertakesBookPurpose.preventionEvidence: Transfer notes explain which operating moves generalize and which outputs were not run.

technicalExplainerVoice.producerGuard: Translate every feature into when the reader would open it, what it can reach, what can fail and the next useful move.
technicalExplainerVoice.preventionEvidence: Taxonomy appears as a practical chooser rather than a product brochure.

draftArchitecture.plainAnswer: Start in Claude Chat with the model your account provides, give it a bounded job and authoritative source pack, inspect the real output, and move to a Project, Research, Cowork, Claude Code or the API only when that surface solves a named context, access, execution or integration need.
causalSequence: Orient the account and make privacy, memory, training and permissions deliberate before uploading work.
Route the job by what Claude must read, remember, create or act on; only then choose the available model and effort.
Build the proposal pack from an approved brief, rough notes and a spreadsheet whose authority is explicitly ordered.
Inspect every promise, number, private-data boundary and deliverable; correct the exact unsupported promise everywhere it appears.
Export or preserve the usable result, record unresolved facts and stop without sending or presenting it.
draftArchitecture.workedCase: A constructed but complete leadership-proposal workflow using an approved brief, rough brainstorm notes and a spreadsheet to create a short presentation, speaker notes, one-page summary and email draft in Claude Chat or a Project.
draftArchitecture.transferCase: A source-backed research briefing, a bounded Cowork file job and a separate small repository correction in Claude Code showing where each paid surface changes the route.
draftArchitecture.usefulAction: Complete one bounded proposal pack on the available Free route, check each promise and figure against the controlling source, make one targeted repair and save the final materials outside the chat.

analogyPlan.analogy: A magazine clipping folder can contain a signed announcement and a scribbled maybe-note; proximity does not give them equal authority.
analogyPlan.mapping: Approved brief outranks brainstorm notes even when both are in the same Project.
analogyPlan.limit: Claude context is processed text, not a physical folder, and authority must be stated rather than inferred from appearance.
analogyPlan.whyItHelps: It makes the source-policy defect visible without requiring technical vocabulary.

analogyPlan.analogy: A large video-store membership lets you browse more shelves; it does not make every tape relevant to tonight's choice.
analogyPlan.mapping: A larger context window can hold more material, but a small high-signal source set is easier to direct and inspect.
analogyPlan.limit: Claude can retrieve and summarize material; it is not literally scanning shelves and capacity is not the same as attention or accuracy.
analogyPlan.whyItHelps: It prevents the common mistake of uploading everything because the model can accept it.

humourPlan.lessonJob: Use restrained lines such as 'High effort is a setting, not a tiara' only after explaining the observable reason to raise effort; keep the work, not the joke, in charge.

draftArchitecture.formatSpecificStructure: Quick start; account and settings; surface map; privacy and permissions; model/effort chooser; complete leadership-proposal workflow; files/web/research; Projects and Artifacts; Cowork; separate Claude Code repository example and extensions; API boundary; verification, troubleshooting and recovery; quick chooser/index; dated source appendix.
draftArchitecture.antiTemplateDecision: Use one continuous example and occasional compact plan-visibility blocks; do not make every section repeat the same seven-field card.

communicationDesign.surfaceAdaptation: Make hidden source authority, context selection, tool reach and permission consequences visible through one continuous job while preserving quick-reference routes.

humanQuestion.reason: The reader needs finished work, not a product tour.
humanQuestion.plannedEvidence: Open with a leadership deadline and scattered source material.

usefulCuriosity.reason: A polished proposal can quietly promote an unapproved idea.
usefulCuriosity.plannedEvidence: Ask which sentence changed status before tracing it to the lower-authority note.

invisibleProcessConcrete.reason: Context, retrieval, permissions and model routing are mostly hidden.
invisibleProcessConcrete.plannedEvidence: Show the exact source pack, prompt, output excerpt and correction chain.

familiarTechnicalMovement.reason: Product terms become useful only after the job boundary is clear.
familiarTechnicalMovement.plannedEvidence: Move from ordinary folder and launch work to Project, Artifact, Cowork, Code and API labels, then back to the deliverable.

limitationsConsequences.reason: Privacy, unsupported promises and external actions can create real harm.
limitationsConsequences.plannedEvidence: Exclude participant data, require approval for sending or publishing and preserve unresolved facts.

humourSurprise.reason: A short line can puncture maximum-effort and magic-prompt thinking.
humourSurprise.plannedEvidence: Place wit only after the cause-and-effect explanation.

betterNextQuestion.reason: The reader needs a durable way to choose among changing products.
betterNextQuestion.plannedEvidence: End decisions with what access, evidence or consequence changes the route.

explanationArc.adaptation: The reference answers urgent questions first, while the central case carries a connected mechanism and earned correction.

representativeProofPlan.highestRisk: The manuscript could become a model catalogue, hide paid-only routes, invent controls, or teach a polished proposal that turns brainstorm notes into approved promises or spreadsheet values into unchecked claims.
representativeProofPlan.plannedProof: Write the complete proposal source set, Free-first prompt, sample outputs, authority defect, targeted repair, cross-surface route and explicit no-send/no-present stop line before expanding the lookup chapters.
representativeProofPlan.acceptanceOutcome: A Free-only reader can create the complete pack as text, explain why the brainstorm note lost, verify the figures, repair every dependent occurrence and identify exactly what paid surfaces would and would not change.
